description: Implement simplified Mohist workflow with 3 core Agents (Planner, Coder, Reviewer). Plan/Review details customized via Prompt.

tasks.title: Update Stage enum and types
tasks.description: Update the Stage enum in types/index.ts to support new workflow stages: Explore, Plan, Build, Review, Done. Update issue type definitions if needed. Map old stages to new stages for backward compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage enum includes Explore, Plan, Build, Review, Done
Existing code that references old stages continues to work
tasks.notes: Foundational task - other tasks depend on the new stage definitions

tasks.title: Create WorkflowController
tasks.description: Create the WorkflowController class that manages workflow execution and stage transitions. Implement basic stage execution framework with transition validation.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowController can execute different stages based on issue state
Controller can invoke appropriate agents for each stage
tasks.notes: Simplified design - no LoopController, agents handle iteration themselves

tasks.title: Create ChangeArtifactsManager
tasks.description: Implement ChangeArtifactsManager that handles creation, reading, and writing of change artifacts in .mohist/changes/ directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Can create change directory with correct structure
Can read and write artifact files
Artifacts are stored in correct locations
tasks.notes: Can be developed in parallel with T-002

tasks.title: Implement Planner Agent
tasks.description: Create Planner Agent that generates design artifacts (proposal, design, specs, prd.json) and self-reviews them. Review dimensions defined via Prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Planner Agent can explore codebase and generate design
Self-reviews design according to Prompt-defined criteria
tasks.notes: Planner Agent fully implemented with exploreCodebase, generateArtifacts, selfReview, fixIssues. Uses write_file tool via tool registry. Default prompt template provided in TypeScript constant and YAML file.

tasks.title: Fix Planner Agent file generation
tasks.description: Fix Planner Agent to actually generate and write artifact files. Either add write_file tool or change implementation to return structured content that code writes to files.
acceptanceCriteria: Planner Agent successfully creates proposal.md, design.md, specs/, prd.json
Files are written to correct location
tasks.notes: Fixed by ensuring createChangeDir is called before generateArtifacts, and using artifactManager.writeArtifact for file operations

tasks.title: Extract Planner Prompt to YAML files
tasks.description: Move Planner Agent default prompt from embedded TypeScript string to YAML files in src/agents/prompts/ directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent loads prompt from file at runtime
tasks.notes: Created prompt-loader.ts, planner-default.yaml, planner-self-review.yaml. Agent loads from file at runtime.

tasks.title: Implement Build phase execution
tasks.description: Create Build phase execution logic that reads prd.json and sequentially executes tasks using Coder Agent (spawn_coder). Implement task failure handling with retry.
acceptanceCriteria: Can read and parse prd.json tasks
Handles task failures with retry (up to 3 times)
Escalates to user when all retries fail
tasks.notes: Coder Agent is called via spawn_coder tool

tasks.title: Add task status tracking in Build phase
tasks.description: Implement task status updates during Build phase execution. Track pending → in_progress → completed/failed status for each task.
acceptanceCriteria: Task status updated in prd.json after each task execution
tasks.notes: updateTaskStatus method implemented in ChangeArtifactsManager, used by WorkflowController during Build phase

tasks.title: Implement Reviewer Agent
tasks.description: Create Reviewer Agent that reviews code quality. Review dimensions (correctness, complexity, test coverage, security) defined via Prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Reviewer Agent can analyze code in the worktree
Reviews code according to Prompt-defined dimensions
Provides structured output with pass/fail and issues
tasks.notes: ReviewerAgent fully implemented with review method, multi-dimensional analysis (correctness, complexity, test_coverage, security), and structured output

tasks.title: Improve Reviewer Agent test execution
tasks.description: Update Reviewer Agent to try 'npm test' first, then 'npm run build' as fallback. Check package.json scripts to determine available commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Reports test/build failures as correctness issues

tasks.title: Extract Reviewer Prompt to YAML files
tasks.description: Move Reviewer Agent default prompt from embedded TypeScript string to YAML files in src/agents/prompts/ directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent loads prompt from file at runtime

tasks.title: Implement user approval interface
tasks.description: Create user approval mechanism for Plan and Review phases. Implement conversation-style interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: System can pause and wait for user approval at Plan and Review phases
User can approve, request changes, or abort
State transitions work correctly based on user input
tasks.notes: CRITICAL: Current implementation doesn't actually pause for approval. Need to integrate with ask_user tool.

tasks.title: Integrate with existing issue service
tasks.description: Update existing issue service and CLI commands to work with new workflow. Refactor Main Agent to use WorkflowController.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue create/start commands work with new workflow
Existing issues can transition to new stages
Status queries return correct workflow state
Main Agent refactored to call WorkflowController
tasks.notes: CRITICAL: Main Agent doesn't call WorkflowController yet. Major refactoring needed.

tasks.title: Create write_file tool
tasks.description: Create write_file tool that agents can use to write files. This is required for Planner Agent to generate artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool can write files to specified path
Registered in Main Agent's tool registry
tasks.notes: Required for Planner Agent file generation

tasks.title: Refactor Main Agent to use WorkflowController
tasks.description: Refactor Main Agent initialization and execution flow to use WorkflowController instead of old workflow logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Main Agent initializes WorkflowController with all dependencies

tasks.title: Add tests and documentation
tasks.description: Add comprehensive tests for new workflow components. Update documentation with new workflow usage guide.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for all major components (>80% coverage)
tasks.notes: Test error handling and edge cases
